messages:
marta: FYI console charts got sluggish after today's routing policy rollout to EU. Heatmaps freeze ~300-800ms longer, sparklines stutter.

jason: saw that too. chart_draw_ms telemetry jumped at 11:03 UTC. Is this the quota rebalancing change? :thinking: 

deploy-bot: Canary rollout eu-routing-v2 started (id: eu-rt-2026-03-20) -> 5% traffic

priya: I rolled the routing policy that biases low-cost pools + stricter per-route quotas. Didn't touch client bundles.

sam: can you paste the routing change snippet? wondering if header-affinity was toggled.

priya: sure:
```
policy: {
  route_affinity: "cost-first",
  per_route_quota: { default: 100, console: 25 }
}
```

kevin: chart backend p95 stayed same, but client main-thread CPU spiked. looks like more JS work per tile.

marta: I profiled a canary session — renderer preflight now does extra validation for quota headers, plus we re-serialize cached tiles more often. suspecting our cache key drift.

jason: cache key drift? you mean we changed the key derivation with region tag?

marta: yeah, the routing change adds region suffix to cache keys which disables kvcache hits for existing tiles.

sam: that explains the spike. evictions + re-parsing SVG paths = CPU jank. we should hotfix by tolerating old keys.

priya: can we patch the kvcache lookup to try both keys (old || new) in 10min window? quick rollback if not.

kevin: quick patch LGTM. minimal risk: try dual-lookup in read path, no writes change.

deploy-bot: Patch available: kvcache-dual-lookup (PR #2419) -> queued for canary 11:30 UTC

marta: running UX smoke: charts in canary look stable, chart_draw_ms p95 down 60% vs rollout spike. rolling patch to 25% now.

jason: can we add telemetry counter for key-miss-rate so we don't regress again?

priya: yes adding metric and an alert. Also drafting a doc to avoid changing cache key formats without migration plan.

marta: thanks all. follow-up: we'll schedule a rollback test and add a small migration in the next deploy window to rehydrate keys.

kevin: +1. also file a postmortem blameless note with timeline.

marta: filing now. :spiral_notepad:
